g.title: J_EPS
g.text: Samtec TFM-120 vertical (was FTSH-120), SFSDT socket
EPS board J3, bottom side, +X edge

g.title: W3
g.text: Samtec SFSDT discrete-wire assembly, PTFE, 30 AWG

EEE-INST-002 derating, N = 40: 30 AWG carries 0.65 A per wire; 3V3_OBC 0.088 A per wire at the SW10 trip (14 %), VBAT_MTQ 0.20 A per wire at the SW11 limit (31 %). AGND joins GND at one point on the EPS. Every OBC output is high-impedance at OBC reset and held low by 100 k on the EPS. EOL_ARM and EOL_FIRE sit on different MCU ports (F, G) and different cable rows

g.title: J_OBC
g.text: Samtec TFM-120 right-angle (was FTSH-120), SFSDT socket
OBC board J1, top side, +X edge, cable toward +X (STM32L4R5ZIT6 pins as labelled)
